notes: Drawing Grids: a drawing can no longer get stuck at Searching. Only the drawing being searched shows Searching, the others show Waiting, and a drawing that can't be searched shows Search Failed with the reason and Search Again. New: right-click a grid line > Number From Here to name that line and every line after it in order (1, 2, 3 or A, B, C) from a start you choose, in the direction you choose, optionally skipping I and O. Claude can now use every part of Drawing Grids: search, name and number lines, add or remove lines and crossings, confirm, match scale and matching names, each undone with one Ctrl+Z.
